notes: PERFECT SCORE: With-skill achieved 100% pass rate (9/9 assertions) across all 3 new feature tests.

TYPED PROPERTIES: With-skill used property:set type= correctly for all 4 types (date, number, checkbox, list). Without-skill wrote raw YAML which works at the file level but doesn't register property types in Obsidian's index.

TASK VERBOSE/DAILY: With-skill used exactly the 3 documented CLI commands (tasks todo verbose, tasks daily total, tasks done total). Without-skill wrote a 40-line Python script to walk all files (30 tool calls, 55K tokens vs 14 calls, 43K tokens).
VAULT PROPERTY ANALYSIS: With-skill completed all 3 queries in 7 tool calls / 50s / 20K tokens. Without-skill needed 13 calls / 103s / 31K tokens — 2x slower and 60% more tokens.

KEY INSIGHT: The new features (type=, verbose, daily, sort=count counts, format=json) are 100% skill-dependent — without the skill, agents have zero knowledge of these parameters and fall back to manual scripting.
COMBINED WITH ITERATION 2: Overall skill pass rate across all 10 evals is (0.90 * 7 + 1.0 * 3) / 10 = 93%.
